greeting: Consulate day. The envelope is already packed from yesterday; today you just carry it in. Ten months of paperwork for your Spanish nationality comes down to one morning.
nextAction: Shoes on, short walk around the block, then leave early for the consulate with the envelope plus the originals of your Mexican passport and proof of address.

quotes.text: Caminante, no hay camino, se hace camino al andar.
quotes.author: Antonio Machado

quotes.text: El que lee mucho y anda mucho, ve mucho y sabe mucho.
quotes.author: Miguel de Cervantes

habits.title: Move: walk before you leave
habits.detail: When I finish breakfast, I will put on shoes and walk outside for 20 minutes, before opening the laptop. Short on time today? 5 minutes counts, and walking part of the way to the consulate counts too.

habits.title: SelfControl block
habits.detail: When I come back from the walk (or the consulate), I will start SelfControl for x.com, youtube.com and linkedin.com before reading anything.

habits.title: LinkedIn post
habits.detail: Next up is Comunidad Antesis. Publish before the block starts, never by scrolling the feed.

habits.title: List one item for sale
habits.detail: Photograph one thing you don't use and send it to the coach; the listing gets written for you.

goals.title: Consulate: hand in the nationality envelope
goals.detail: Go early. Bring the envelope (actas, copies, both signed forms) and the originals of your Mexican passport and proof of address. Ask how they will notify you about the matrícula and the passport appointment.

goals.title: Draft the Comunidad Antesis LinkedIn post (15 min)
goals.detail: Carried over since 11-05. Ask the coach for a draft about multi-country pricing for real buyers in several countries; you only read, tweak and save it.

goals.title: Remove the CodeRabbit line from the resume
goals.detail: Resume(v12-fixed).pdf in Google Drive, or the online builder it came from. Until then send cv/main_example.pdf from ~/c/ai-job-search.
